hotspots.title: Fidesz-Tisza feud over Hungary's future
hotspots.blurb: Hungary's political landscape is dominated by a bitter feud between Fidesz, led by Viktor Orbán, and the Tisza Party, led by Péter Magyar. The conflict centers on constitutional changes, media freedom, and allegations of corruption, sparking mass protests and legal battles.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to the high-stakes power struggle, allegations of authoritarianism, and the broader implications for Hungary's democracy and EU relations.
